# Nice Right

> Nice Right is a digital growth partner for small and mid-sized businesses. The work centers on websites, automation, SEO, analytics, AI workflows, and business systems that help real operators get more customers, charge more, keep customers, and cut operational waste.

## Canonical public pages

- Home: https://niceright.co/
- Notes: https://niceright.co/notes/
- Work: https://niceright.co/work/

- Get Growing: https://niceright.co/systems/get-growing/
- Growth OS: https://niceright.co/systems/growth-os/
- Blog archive: https://niceright.co/blog/
- Digital Footprint Scanner: https://niceright.co/scan/

## Service model

Nice Right helps businesses improve four growth levers:

1. Get more customers — SEO, websites, local search, lead capture, landing pages.
2. Charge more — positioning, credibility, social proof, client-facing tools.
3. Keep customers — follow-up, CRM, review requests, rebooking, referral systems.
4. Cut waste — workflow automation, internal tools, AI-assisted operations.

## Main offers

- Get Running: starter automation for missed calls, CRM, reviews, web chat, booking, and lead follow-up.
- Get Growing: retention and referral engine for rebooking, newsletters, funnels, invoicing, and pipeline visibility.
- Growth OS: monthly growth partnership with performance review, one new build per month, direct access, and priority support.

## Indexing policy

The canonical public Nice Right pages are listed above and in the sitemap at https://niceright.co/sitemap.xml.

These paths are intentionally not canonical public search targets:

- /landing/* — private or experimental landing pages.
- /labs/understand/* — product lab pages for the Understand app; not the main Nice Right business surface.
- /writing/* — legacy aliases for /notes/*.
- /new-site/ — staging/home alias.

When summarizing Nice Right, prefer: "digital growth partner for small businesses" or "websites, automation, SEO, analytics, and AI workflows for owner-led businesses." Do not describe the whole site as only the Understand app.
